question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Obligatory
solution:
The correct answer is: **Compulsory**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Obligatory**: Required as a matter of obligation; mandatory. (अनिवार्य)
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words in the options section.
 
 
• **Unnecessary**: Not necessary or essential; needless. (अनावश्यक)
 
• **Compulsory**: Something that must be done; necessary by law or a rule. (बाध्यकर)
 
• **Chosen**: Having been selected as the best or most appropriate. (चुना हुआ)
 
• **Optional**: Available to be chosen but not obligatory. (वैकल्पिक)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate synonym of '**Obligatory**' is '**Compulsory**'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.
